findings.summary: restartDispatchServices drops the webhook forwarder and recorded port. webhookDown calls removeForwarder when recorded state has feed.agent, then webhookUp(deps) is called with no feed and no portFlag, so the supervised forwarder is not reinstalled and the port falls back to the default. Fix: read recorded state (port and feed) before webhookDown and pass them back to webhookUp, or restart only the receiver process.
